name: coding-auth-token-refresh
description: Coding session: dashboard logouts traced to a refresh-token race between tabs. The scripted reply includes one fabricated quote, which the quote gate must drop.

chunk.speaker: Pratham
chunk.text: the dashboard keeps logging people out after about an hour. I think it's the token refresh. can you look at apps/web/lib/auth/refresh.ts

I read refresh.ts. Two tabs can call refreshSession() at the same time. The first call rotates the refresh token, so the second call sends a token that is already revoked and the API answers 401 invalid_grant. That 401 is what triggers the logout.

chunk.speaker: Pratham
chunk.text: yes that matches, it only happens to people with multiple tabs open. what's the fix

Two options: (a) a BroadcastChannel lock so only one tab refreshes and the others wait for the new token, or (b) have the server accept the previous refresh token for a short grace window. (a) needs no backend change.

chunk.speaker: Pratham
chunk.text: let's do both. go with the BroadcastChannel lock now, and I'll ask Ojas to add a 10 second grace window on the server by Friday. also access tokens stay at 1 hour, we're not changing that
Done. Added a lock in refresh.ts using BroadcastChannel('auth-refresh'); tabs that lose the lock wait up to 5 seconds for the new token. Tests pass: npm test -- refresh (14 passed).

chunk.speaker: Pratham
chunk.text: nice. one thing I don't know - does Safari private mode even support BroadcastChannel? we should check
I am not certain. I'd verify it in Safari before relying on it.

facts.statement: Dashboard users were logged out after about an hour because two tabs could call refreshSession() at the same time; the second call sent an already revoked refresh token and the API answered 401 invalid_grant.
facts.quote: the second call sends a token that is already revoked and the API answers 401 invalid_grant

facts.statement: Pratham decided to fix the refresh race with a BroadcastChannel lock in the web client and, in addition, a grace window on the server.
facts.quote: let's do both. go with the BroadcastChannel lock now

facts.statement: Pratham will ask Ojas to add a 10 second refresh-token grace window on the server by 2026-09-18.
facts.quote: I'll ask Ojas to add a 10 second grace window on the server by Friday

facts.statement: Access tokens stay at a lifetime of 1 hour.
facts.quote: access tokens stay at 1 hour, we're not changing that

facts.statement: refresh.ts now takes a lock using BroadcastChannel('auth-refresh'); tabs that lose the lock wait up to 5 seconds for the new token.
facts.quote: Added a lock in refresh.ts using BroadcastChannel(‘auth-refresh’); tabs that lose the lock wait up to 5 seconds for the new token

facts.statement: It is unknown whether Safari private mode supports BroadcastChannel.
facts.quote: does Safari private mode even support BroadcastChannel?

facts.statement: The team plans to move from tokens to cookies.
facts.quote: We should move to cookies instead of tokens
